descriptions.preferred: This strong upright tree is full sized and has a good fall color. The foliage gives a sturdy appearance, being almeans "the red month of May," but the spring color is a vigorous green which does not darken much in midsummer. Fall is the significant time when the tree becomes brightly colored with flame and crimson foliage. 'Satsuki beni' makes a good background tree in the garden landscape or a shade-producing cover tree for alpines. It probably reaches 8 m in 20 years. The name is sometimes spelled

sources.title: 五月红Acer Palmatum 'Satsuki Beni'
sources.description: 经典的大红叶，带有圆形肥叶，打开时像扇子一样打褶。 柠檬绿的叶子在春天长出红色的尖端，然后在仲夏褪 色成完全的绿色。在秋天，叶子在秋天变成橙红色。 比大多数其他日本枫树品种生长速度更快，并且变得 更大，成年树高可达 4-5 米，树冠宽阔，耐寒性好。

rhs.description: A strong, upright deciduous tree, slowly reaching about 8m in height, with broad, 7-lobed, green leaves with almost smooth edges, to 6cm long, turning bright flame and crimson colours in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一个生长强健、树形直立的大型树种，秋色表现良好。其叶片使植株呈现结实稳健的观感。其名称意为“五月红”，但春季叶色其实是浓健的绿色，到盛夏也不会明显变深。真正出彩的时期在秋季，整株会转为鲜艳的火焰红和深红色。'Satsuki beni' 适合作为园林景观中的背景树，也可作为为高山植物提供遮荫的覆盖树。20 年后高度可能达到 8 米。其名称有时也拼作 'Satzuki beni'。

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。
attributes.suggested_uses: 适合城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境及花坛。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 强健、直立的落叶小乔木，生长缓慢，最终高约 8 米。叶片宽大，7 裂，绿色，叶缘近乎平滑，叶长可达 6 厘米，秋季转为明亮的火焰色与深绯红色。
